Our Materials

We start with premium surplus leather that would otherwise go unused, alongside organic leather from LWG-certified tanneries. Over 80% of our collection is made from upcycled materials and surplus leather, and we never use PU or PVC.

Our hardware is free from lead, cadmium and nickel, and every bag ships in recycled card with an organic cotton dust bag.

Learn more about our materials

Made Through Many Hands

Each piece is cut, sewn, assembled and finished by skilled artisans, with a different pair of hands at every stage. Many of our makers have honed their craft over generations.

Our partner workshops in India are audited through SMETA and SEDEX, and our founders stay closely involved with the teams on the ground.

Meet our community

We Love Being Light

Light on your shoulders, light on your conscience, light on the planet. We don't chase trends and we don't overproduce. We make timeless designs in small batches, with strong stitching, quality hardware and organic cotton linings, so every bag is carried for years.

Sustainability Comes Full Circle

Our approach to manufacturing rests on four commitments: building trust through transparent sourcing, empowering communities with fair work, extending the lifecycle of premium leather, and preserving nature.

Leather Bag Manufacturer FAQs

What types of leather bags do you manufacture?

Crossbody bags, shoulder and hobo bags, tote bags, work bags, backpacks, woven bags, wallets, card holders and laptop sleeves.

What leather do you use?

Our range includes handbags made from Italian leather, alongside organic leather from LWG-certified tanneries and premium surplus leather. We never use PU or PVC.
